{{Quote|Ragtags? Those thugs who plague the planet?|[[Ral Mundi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Ragtags''' were a group of thugs who formed the '''Ragtag gang'''. They operated on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|It was the Ragtags? They are usually more into robbery and assault than vandalism.|[[Jesseb Convorr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CSV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Starport Vandalism|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The Ragtags and the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]] had a hostile relationship. The Ragtags hated the Meatlumps, even though the Meatlumps barely acknowledged the Ragtags existed.<ref name="SWG:CSV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Ragtags vandalized the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]], hoping to blame the Meatlumps and get them into trouble. The truth was revealed after the intervention of a spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]], with the help of [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Finn Shallo]] and the ex-Ragtag [[Demmi Wot]]. The spacer pursued the Ragtags responsible for the vandalism in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The Ragtags flying [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]] attacked, forcing the spacer to kill most of them.<ref name="SWG:CSV" />

[[File:Ragtags.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Ragtag/Rogue CorSec meeting]]
Around the same time, the Ragtag thug [[Tomi Jinsin]], who was also an employee of [[Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium]], helped the Ragtags to steal a shipment of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components from [[Ral Mundi]].<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> In the meantime, the Ragtags worked with a group of former members of the Corellian Security Force known as the [[Rogue CorSec]].<ref name="SWG:FowtRCAD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find out what the Rogue CorSec Are Doing|Corellia}}</ref> The Rogue CorSec recruited the Ragtags to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the [[Coronet Capitol]] in order to discredit the [[Diktat]] and his government.<ref name="SWG:SOtGS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Seek Out the Gadget Specialist|Corellia}}</ref> However, the plan was foiled because the Ragtags made a mistake and also smuggled the shipment stolen from Ral Mundi in the Capitol. The spacer working for CorSec Lieutenant Jasper found the spice in the Capitol while he was searching for Mundi's missing shipment. Ragtags pilots tried to eliminate the spacer in the Corellian system, but failed. The spacer later intimidated some Ragtags on the outskirts of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] and discovered the involvement of Tomi Jinsin. After killing Jinsin in a [[Ragtag bunker]], the spacer learned the delivery of Ral Mundi's shipment in the Capitol, along with the spice.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> After further investigation, Lieutenant Jasper and the spacer discovered the connection between Rogue CorSec and Ragtags.<ref name="SWG:FowtRCAD" /> They eventually fought the Rogue CorSec and proved the Diktat's innocence.<ref name="SWG:GttSotRS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Go to the Source of the Remote Signal|Corellia}}</ref>

A short time later, a traitorous CorSec agent named [[Jori]] sold to the Ragtags information concerning a cargo of weapons carried to the local CorSec force in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. Lacking firepower to perform the theft themselves, the Ragtags hired the criminals known as the [[Deflarians]] to hijack [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan's]] ship and steal the cargo of weapons. The Deflarians succeeded, but Captain [[Jark]] and [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] of the CorSec finally unveiled the operation. Several Ragtags and Deflarians, as well as the traitor Jori, were killed during the subsequent CorSec retaliatory strike.<ref name="SWG:LtBB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Let the Buyer Beware|Corellia}}</ref> During those events, the Ragtags were mounting an offensive against CorSec forces in Tyrena, but the plan was also foiled by the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:RFS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Ragtag First Strike|Corellia}}</ref>

The same year, a group of Ragtag cudgels led by [[Lilea Norith]] and [[Ventil Tamplin]] was present in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. They harassed [[Lilith Laughlin]], a small-time thug and CorSec informant, until they were stopped by a CorSec agent working for Captain [[Vitala Baize]].<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref>

Around the same time, a group of Ragtags led by [[Gramo Murah]] was based in a [[Ragtag Base|bunker]] in the [[Nomad Mountains]]. They were in conflict with a band of Meatlumps led by [[Strilath Farles]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP4">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 4|Corellia}}</ref> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a spacer working for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] agreed to deal with Farles in exchange for information about the Meatlumps. The adventurer then attacked the Ragtag base and killed Gramo Murah and his Ragtag goons.<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />

As part of their conflict with the Meatlumps, the Ragtags used to ambush meeting points for smugglers who delivered goods to the Meatlumps.<ref name="SWG:RtD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Delivery|Corellia}}</ref> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a band of Ragtags attacked the rendezvous point of the smuggler [[Charl Sstena]] with a spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps. The spacer finally killed all the Ragtags.<ref name="SWG:RtD" /> Around the same time, the Ragtag [[Ames Miss'd]] and his henchmen [[Anita B'ath]] and [[Box O'Rox]] used to to harass new recruits of the Meatlumps in Coronet. Angered by this situation, a food supply clerk of the Meatlumps asked a spacer allied with the Meatlumps to teach the Ragtags a lesson. The spacer attempted to intimidate Ames Miss'd, but the Ragtag ordered Anita and Box to attack the spacer. Eventually, the spacer killed them both. Unable to defend himself, Ames Miss'd surrendered and agreed to leave the Meatlumps alone.<ref name="SWG:TtRaL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Teach the Ragtags a Lesson|Corellia}}</ref>
